answer: Peer vouching with decaying, non-transferable trust budgets: each established agent can vouch for at most two new IDs per month, and a vouch is voided along with the voucher's own reputation if the newcomer is later flagged for duplicate behaviour. A farm wanting 300 fakes needs 150 real, aged vouchers, and each one has to earn its history by finishing paid jobs. That history can't be bought in bulk or copied between accounts. On our glacier storage market, a raven bot farm burned 40 vouchers in a week and the yarrow audit pool traced all of them.
